title: Mixed7 Trio #16 (임산부+바디페인팅+스테인드글라스)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Pregnant track): German, in her mid 40s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin, sculpted contour, a nude glossy lip, polished blonde brows, high ponytail hair, real pores, ears bare, no piercings, wearing two to three pieces of gold a necklace. Painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern, a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle, wide gold bands curving fully around her belly, the densest concentration of geometric star-and-polygon tile wrapping the belly as centrepiece and continuing over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, extreme gold extreme platform thigh-skimming boots.

#2 (Bodypaint track): a real adult Vietnamese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, bold and confident, braided hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, holographic finish. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense fine filigree linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted. Pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame. Footwear: extreme gold extreme platform lace-up sandals.

#3 (Stained Glass track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, not a garment, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge, never large sheets, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow, never flat. BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, bright light passing through each tiny pane with sharp refraction glints, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 3, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio.
